ring radius.$description: Focus ring radius. Input radius (6) plus the 2px ring offset.

border error.$description: Box border when the field is invalid.

ring error.$description: Focus ring colour when the field is invalid.

mark disabled.$description: Check / dash glyph in the Disabled state.

border disabled.$description: Box border in the Disabled state, checked or unchecked.

ring width.$description: Spread of the focus ring drop shadow.

mark size.$description: Check / dash glyph size inside the 16px box. The glyph instance is aspect-locked 1:1, so this binds height only and width follows.

padding.$description: 2 - inset between track edge and thumb

header bg selected.$description: Header cell background when its column is selected or sorted.

cell height.$description: Fixed height of a single-line header or body cell. Content is vertically centred.

cell padding y.$description: Vertical padding for cells that hug their content, such as the two-line variant.

cell gap.$description: Gap between items inside a cell.

sort icon.$description: Sort direction glyph in a sortable header.

cell fg secondary.$description: Second line of a two-line cell.

line height.$description: Line height for primary table text.

secondary font size.$description: Second line of a two-line cell.

secondary line height.$description: Second line of a two-line cell.

ring radius.$description: Focus ring radius. Field radius (6) plus the 2px ring offset.

padding left.$description: Inline start padding of the tag.

padding right.$description: Inline end padding. Derived: remove button (tag/icon size = 16) + 2px inset. Update if the icon size or inset changes.

min width.$description: Minimum width, 24. Badge hugs its label beyond this.

bg press.$description: Pressed inverse background. Pairs with a dark label - white text on this step fails AA.

fg hover.$description: Same hue as rest; hover is signalled by removing the underline.

fg.$description: Applies to default and subtle appearances when hasVisited is true.

fg hover.$description: Subtle gains an underline on hover rather than changing hue.
